Cybernetic '''ion shielding''' was a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] upgrade that shielded an implant from the effects of [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion weaponry]]. Ion shielding was costly, increasing the cost of an individual implant by a thousand credits; additionally, ion shielding relied on group immunity &mdash; if even a single installed implant lacked ion shielding, then all implants were vulnerable to damage, regardless of installed shielding.<ref name="GAW" />
